scope: reuse prior scores; partial external work may still be running

120.scope: existing endpoint 120s, last 60-second window, same-source, same-mask, actual-seed-paired scores; exploratory exposed development data

configuration.frame_sampling: whole prefix, every decoded frame. i2v_subject: DINO ViT-B/16 (Resize 256 + CenterCrop 224 on source image and frames); i2v_background: DreamSim ensemble at 224x224 (squash); score = 0.4*max(source-to-frame sim) + 0.3*mean(consecutive) + 0.3*min(consecutive). Source image = snf-bench prompts/v2/i2v/images/<id>.jpg (832x480, same file for every model)

VBench-Long long_custom_input: each prefix split into clips of int(avg_fps)*2 frames (2 s; 32 @16 fps, 30 @15 fps), clips [k*L,(k+1)*L), a remainder becomes one extra clip extended backwards to L frames (overlapping the previous one); clips decoded with decord and RE-ENCODED by torchvision.io.write_video (PyAV/libx264, official behaviour) into stage/split_clip/<stem>/<stem>_NNN.mp4; short scorers run on every clip (all frames); SC/BC additionally score a video of the first frame of every clip (DINOv2 / DreamSim), mapped via the official mapping tables and fused 0.5/0.5 (dev_flag, slow_fast_params.yaml)

limitations: input hashes checked against stored records, not rehashed video bytes
distinct metric populations retained per metric
same benchmark sources, not independent datasets
no human validity, independent confirmation, or claims of causal significance
